lines.zh: 我颠着走，肚子一弹一弹。
lines.en: I bob along, my belly bouncing.
I hum a tune and slip around a tree.

lines.zh: 我的肚子先到，身体后到。
lines.en: My belly arrives first, then the rest of me.
I hop each step, as if playing.
I skim the grass, my shadow tiny.
I walk and lick sugar off my hand.

lines.zh: 我一会儿左一会儿右，没有直线。
lines.en: Left, then right; I never walk straight.
I float to your back, quickly.

lines.zh: 我一蹦一跳，地面没声音。
lines.en: I bounce along without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的披风拖在身后，像尾巴。
lines.en: My cape trails behind like a tail.

lines.zh: 我蹦起来三格高，才落下。
lines.en: I bounce three blocks up before landing.
I walk in circles because it's fun.
I sit and swing both legs.

lines.zh: 我的肚子鼓鼓的，很有弹性。
lines.en: My belly is round and springy.
I blow a bubble and watch it pop.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，空气甜甜的。
lines.en: I hiccup, and the air tastes sweet.

lines.zh: 我戳了戳肚子，它弹回来。
lines.en: I poke my belly and it bounces right back.
I flip over in the air.
I hear a fight far off.

lines.zh: 我把披风拉正，又拉歪了。
lines.en: I straighten my cape, then tilt it again.

lines.zh: 我等得无聊，就去滚一圈。
lines.en: Bored of waiting, I roll over once.
Nice weather for a fight.

lines.zh: 我的天线晃了晃，收到点什么。
lines.en: My antenna wobbles, picking something up.

lines.zh: 我笑出声，自己也不知道为什么。
lines.en: I laugh, not sure why.
You look like fun.
Can I turn you into candy?

lines.zh: 我歪着头，看你举起武器。
lines.en: I tilt my head as you raise a weapon.

lines.zh: 你的脸好严肃，笑一个嘛。
lines.en: Your face is so serious; smile a little.
I float up close in front of you.
You're not running; more fun for me.
You've got ki on you; I smell it.
I lick my lips and look at you.
You're a bit taller than the last one.

lines.zh: 我伸出手指，想戳你的鼻子。
lines.en: I reach out a finger to poke your nose.
If you hit me, I'll laugh.
Shall we play a while?
I float a full circle around you.

lines.zh: 你的帽子歪了，我帮你吹正。
lines.en: Your hat is crooked; I'll puff it straight.

lines.zh: 我不饿，但我喜欢咬东西。
lines.en: I'm not hungry, but I like biting things.
Try floating too?
I stare at the bread in your hand.
You don't even blink; so boring.

lines.zh: 我凹了一块，很快鼓回来。
lines.en: I dent, then plump back quickly.
It hurts, but it's fun too.
I spin twice from the hit.
I whine and float backward.
You hit me; impressive.
I rub where I was struck.

lines.zh: 我的身体晃了晃，像果冻。
lines.en: My body wobbles like jelly.
I stop laughing, just for a moment.
I swell up bigger than before.
That sweet thing, give it here.
I smell sugar; it's lovely.
I reach for it, fast.
I could eat ten, honestly.
I circle that thing.
Sweet things make me happy.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，等你自己递过来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and wait for you to hand it over.

lines.zh: 你手上那点东西，够我塞牙缝。
lines.en: What's in your hand barely fills a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的肚子，弹了回来。
lines.en: You bounce off my belly.
I'm soft; bumping won't hurt.
We collide, and I giggle.

lines.zh: 我的身体凹了一下，又鼓回来。
lines.en: My body dents, then plumps back.
You slide right off me.
One push from me sends you far.
Bumping me doesn't anger me; it's fun.

lines.zh: 我的披风绕住了你的腿。
lines.en: My cape tangles around your legs.
We tumble together like a ball.
I press against your back, light as air.

lines.zh: 另一个圆滚滚的飘过来。
lines.en: Another round one floats over.
We bump, then bounce apart.
She likes sweets too; wonderful.

lines.zh: 我们分一块糖，一人一半。
lines.en: We split a candy, half each.
We snore side by side, loudly.
We spin in flight until dizzy.

lines.zh: 她的天线跟我的碰到一起。
lines.en: Her antenna brushes mine.
We see who bounces higher.
With her here, even fighting has company.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块蛋糕，塞进嘴里。
lines.en: I pick up a piece of cake and stuff it in.

lines.zh: 我抓起一把糖，全塞进去。
lines.en: I scoop a handful of sweets and eat them all.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的剑，咬了一口。
lines.en: I pick up your sword and take a bite.

lines.zh: 我从地上捡起一颗种子。
lines.en: I pick a seed off the ground.
I pick up a stone and throw it far.

lines.zh: 我拾起你的帽子，戴上了。
lines.en: I pick up your hat and put it on.
I lift a whole cow.
I pick up a wisp of ki and roll it into a ball.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的糖纸，看了看。
lines.en: I pick up a dropped candy wrapper and study it.
I pick up a plank and gnaw it.

lines.zh: 你打了我一下，那就玩吧。
lines.en: You hit me, so let's play.
I grin, eyes narrowing to slits.
The ki on you is decent.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，掌心有小气弹。
lines.en: I raise a hand, a small ki blast in the palm.
I start chasing, fast.
You run amusingly.
First I'll play, then eat.
You're locked in; that's that.
Did you just call me names?
I'm angry, just a little.
Stand still; I'll count to three.
I float up, a head above you.
That direction; fine, I'm coming.
I want what's in your hand.
Let's fight; it'll be quick.
I circle you, high then low.
You run left, and I'm already there.
I stretch out a hand, fingertips glowing.
Nice dodge; again.
I chase, laughing, not tired at all.
You hide behind a tree; the tree's gone.
Little ki blasts lob over, one by one.

lines.zh: 你的攻击穿过去，我没事。
lines.en: Your attack goes through me; I'm fine.

lines.zh: 我飘在你头顶，等你抬头。
lines.en: I hover overhead, waiting for you to look up.
The more you run, the happier I am.
I've closed off your way back.
I go suddenly quiet.
Listen, my stomach is growling.
Don't run so far; I can keep up.
I crack my knuckles.
You look cute holding that shield.
I'll wait for you to finish that breath.
I punch you in the stomach.
My fist is soft, but heavy.
I kick once, and you fly.
I grab your collar and spin you.
I bite once; not tasty.

lines.zh: 小气弹贴着你的脸炸开。
lines.en: A small ki blast bursts by your face.
I punch, laughing, one after another.

lines.zh: 你挡得住手，挡不住肚子。
lines.en: You can block my hands, not my belly.
I sit down on you.
I grab your blade and bend it.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，尘土炸开。
lines.en: I clap a palm down, and dust bursts out.

lines.zh: 我弹了一下手指，声音很脆。
lines.en: I flick a finger, and it cracks sharp.
I fly up and slam down on you.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的脚，拖了半圈。
lines.en: I catch your foot and drag you half a turn.

lines.zh: 这一拳我笑到一半打完。
lines.en: I finish this punch mid-laugh.

lines.zh: 我从圣界的云里飘下来。
lines.en: I drift down from the Sacred World's clouds.
I'm hungry; let's find something to do.
The air here is sweet.
I hear shouting; so noisy.
I hover and look the place over.
Will someone play with me?

lines.zh: 我把披风拉好，出场要有样子。
lines.en: I fix my cape; make an entrance.
The sky is blue and I'm happy.
The moment I appear, the birds flee.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔手指，先尝尝空气。
lines.en: I lick a finger and taste the air.

lines.zh: 我数了数附近的人，一个。
lines.en: I count the people nearby: one.

lines.zh: 我笑起来，声音传得很远。
lines.en: I laugh, and it carries far.

lines.zh: 我落在一棵树上，树弯了。
lines.en: I land on a tree, and it bends.
Something good will happen today.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤烤焦了，有点香。
lines.en: My skin scorches, and it smells oddly good.

lines.zh: 我从天上掉下来，弹了两下。
lines.en: I drop from the sky and bounce twice.

lines.zh: 我喝了一肚子水，鼓得更圆。
lines.en: I swallow a belly of water and grow rounder.

lines.zh: 我被炸得散开，又聚回来。
lines.en: The blast scatters me, and I gather again.

lines.zh: 箭插在我肚子上，痒痒的。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my belly; it tickles.
A spell has me tangled.
I'm too hungry to laugh.

lines.zh: 雷打我身上，我头发都竖了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me, and my hair stands.

lines.zh: 我掉进黑里，找不到方向。
lines.en: I fall into the dark and lose all direction.
